subgroup stream (type 0x18: end-of-group marker set, Subgroup ID mode zero, priority present) with one 4-byte object. Draft-15 Section 10.4.2 Table 6 puts the end-of-group marker at 0x08 and uses 0x06 as a two-bit Subgroup ID mode, so 0x18 is the end-of-group form of 0x10; type 0x12 is mode 0b01, where the Subgroup ID is the first object's Object ID and is not transmitted

Draft-15 Section 10.4.2 Table 6 gives this type no Subgroup ID field and a Subgroup ID Value of First Object ID: the Subgroup ID is the Object ID of the first object transmitted, which the first Object ID Delta carries

subgroup stream (type 0x11: extensions present) with one status-only object (End of Group) carrying a non-empty extensions blob. Draft-15 Section 10.2.1.2 allows extension headers only on an object whose status is Normal and requires an endpoint receiving them on any other status to close the session with a PROTOCOL_VIOLATION. The frame is well formed, so this is a case a decoder is expected to parse and then report as a violation, not one it fails to read
